# PayPal
> Digital wallet and payments platform for paying online, sending money, managing finances, and accessing merchant and developer tools.

PayPal serves consumers, businesses, and developers with products for checkout, peer-to-peer payments, invoicing, subscriptions, reporting, and payment integrations. This file prioritizes product, support, and developer resources across paypal.com.

## Consumer Wallet
- [How PayPal Works](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/how-paypal-works?locale.x=en_CA): Overview of using PayPal for purchases, payments, and account management.
- [Digital Wallet](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet?locale.x=en_CA): Main hub for PayPal wallet features, app access, and everyday money tools.
- [Ways to Pay](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay?locale.x=en_CA): Explore checkout options, payment methods, and wallet payment experiences.
- [Manage Your Money](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/manage-money?locale.x=en_CA): Learn about balance management, payment methods, and money tools.
- [Security and Protection](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/security-and-protection?locale.x=en_CA): Consumer security features, fraud monitoring, and account protection information.
- [Account Selection](https://www.paypal.com/ca/webapps/mpp/account-selection?locale.x=en_CA): Sign up flow for choosing and creating a PayPal account.

## Shopping & Rewards
- [Pay in 4](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/buy-now-pay-later?locale.x=en_CA): Buy now, pay later information for eligible purchases and repayment options.
- [Pay with Rewards](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/pay-with-rewards?locale.x=en_CA): Use eligible credit card reward points during checkout with PayPal.
- [Checkout with PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/checkout-with-paypal?locale.x=en_CA): Pay online with PayPal at supported merchants and checkout flows.
- [Add Payment Method](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/add-payment-method?locale.x=en_CA): Add cards and bank accounts to fund PayPal transactions.
- [Ways to Pay Overview](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay?locale.x=en_CA): Central overview of payment methods and wallet checkout choices.

## Send & Receive Money
- [Send & Receive Money](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/send-receive-money?locale.x=en_CA): Overview of personal money transfers and receiving payments with PayPal.
- [Send Money](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/send-money?locale.x=en_CA): Send money to friends, family, and contacts using PayPal.
- [Request Money](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/request-money?locale.x=en_CA): Create payment requests and collect money from others.
- [Manage Your Money](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/manage-money?locale.x=en_CA): Access tools related to balances, funding sources, and money movement.

## Mobile App
- [PayPal App](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet?locale.x=en_CA): Download and use the PayPal app for payments and account access.
- [How PayPal Works](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/how-paypal-works?locale.x=en_CA): Learn core wallet and app capabilities for everyday use.
- [Security and Protection](https://www.paypal.com/ca/digital-wallet/security-and-protection?locale.x=en_CA): Review mobile and account safety features available to users.

## Business Products
- [PayPal for Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business): Overview of business payments, checkout, invoicing, and merchant solutions.
- [Accept Payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments): Business payment acceptance options for online, in-person, and invoiced transactions.
- [Checkout](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/checkout): Merchant checkout solutions for websites, apps, and commerce platforms.
- [Invoicing](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/invoice): Create, send, and manage invoices for customers and business payments.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/subscriptions): Recurring billing tools for subscription businesses and repeat payments.
- [Business Account](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/getting-started): Information on setting up and using a PayPal business account.

## Developer Documentation
- [PayPal Developer](https://developer.paypal.com/): Main developer portal for APIs, SDKs, integration guides, and sandbox tools.
- [Developer Docs](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/): Documentation hub for PayPal APIs, products, and implementation resources.
- [API Reference](https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/): REST API reference for payments, orders, payouts, and related services.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://developer.paypal.com/sdk/js/): Client-side SDK for rendering PayPal buttons and checkout experiences.
- [Server SDKs](https://developer.paypal.com/tools/sdks/): Official SDK resources for integrating PayPal on supported server platforms.
- [Sandbox Accounts](https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard/accounts): Test accounts for building and validating PayPal integrations.
- [Webhooks](https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/webhooks/): Webhook event support for payment status and account notifications.

## Payments APIs
- [Orders API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/orders/v2/): Create and capture orders for PayPal checkout integrations.
- [Payments API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/payments/v2/): Manage authorizations, captures, and refunds for payment transactions.
- [Subscriptions API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/subscriptions/v1/): Create plans and manage recurring subscription billing workflows.
- [Payouts API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1/): Send money to multiple recipients through batch payout operations.
- [Webhooks Management API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/webhooks/v1/): Configure webhook listeners and inspect event delivery settings.
- [Reporting API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/transaction-search/v1/): Search and retrieve transaction reporting data programmatically.

## Integration Guides
- [Accept PayPal Checkout](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/checkout/): End-to-end guidance for implementing PayPal Checkout on web experiences.
- [Standard Checkout](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/checkout/standard/integrate/): Integrate standard PayPal checkout with client and server components.
- [Advanced Checkout](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/checkout/advanced/): Build customized checkout flows with advanced integration patterns.
- [Subscriptions Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/subscriptions/): Guides for implementing recurring billing and subscription management.
- [Payouts Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/payouts/): Learn how to send payouts and automate recipient disbursements.
- [Multiparty Checkout](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/multiparty/): Integration guidance for partner and marketplace payment scenarios.

## Support & Help
- [Help Center](https://www.paypal.com/ca/smarthelp/home): Main support portal for account, payments, and troubleshooting topics.
- [Resolution Center](https://www.paypal.com/disputes/): Manage disputes, claims, and transaction issue resolution.
- [Contact Us](https://www.paypal.com/ca/smarthelp/contact-us): Support contact options for account and payment assistance.
- [Security Center](https://www.paypal.com/ca/webapps/mpp/security/securityhub): Security education, best practices, and protection resources.
- [Fees](https://www.paypal.com/ca/webapps/mpp/paypal-fees): Reference page for PayPal fees applicable in Canada.
- [Legal Agreements](https://www.paypal.com/ca/webapps/mpp/ua/legalhub-full): Legal terms, policies, and user agreement documents.

## Company & News
- [Newsroom](https://newsroom.paypal-corp.com/): Corporate announcements, press releases, and company news updates.
- [Investor Relations](https://investor.pypl.com/): Financial reports, governance materials, and investor information.
- [About PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/about): Company overview, mission, and corporate background.
- [Careers](https://careers.pypl.com/): Job openings, teams, and career information at PayPal.
- [Public Policy](https://publicpolicy.paypal-corp.com/): Policy positions and public affairs information from PayPal.
